title: Source allowlist
description: The trust root: a claim is only `verified` when its citation host is, or is a subdomain of, a domain listed here. Refresh runs may add entries, so every entry must carry a written justification for why the institution is authoritative — that justification is the only record of why a domain was trusted.

domain.description: Registrable hostname, no scheme, no path, no leading dot. Subdomains match automatically, so list the broadest domain that is authoritative and add finer entries only for a better label.

label.description: Canonical source name written onto every claim citing this domain.

justification.description: Why this institution is authoritative for its category. Must be a real sentence, not a restatement of the label.
